Uber Employee Shares Experience After Layoff

An Uber employee, who had recently celebrated four years with the company and risen from a driver to a manager, was laid off. The employee shared their experience, stating that the decision was "just business, not personal." The individual expressed a sentiment of hope rather than anger or regret following the layoff.
